hero.title: Build habits that stick — the science-based way

features.title: Built on behavioral science
features.subtitle: Three ideas from habit research, wired into every check-in.

tiny.title: Tiny Habits method
tiny.body: Anchor a micro-behavior to a routine you already have, then celebrate. Small enough that it can't fail.

automaticity.title: Automaticity tracking
automaticity.body: Rate how automatic each check-in felt from 1 to 10 and watch habit strength build week after week.

recovery.title: Recovery rate
recovery.body: Missed a day? Your recovery rate measures how you bounce back — because progress isn't a perfect streak.

science.title: Consistency beats intensity
science.body: Success rate, habit strength and your best time of day — insights that show where your practice is actually working.
